scope: Tracked first-party production and production-operational source: app routes/pages/UI, client, components, hooks, lib, migrations/*.sql, packages/apex-receiver src/bin plus Docker/package/build config, scripts, server, shared, types, workers, Next proxy and tracked build/runtime/deploy/QA-control configs (including .github workflows, .replit/replit.nix, npm/package/tsconfig/Playwright/PostCSS/Nginx/PM2 configs and deploy.sh). The middleware boundary is proxy.ts; storage code is in lib/storage.ts and the receiver storage implementation.
hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 working-tree bytes. Git status showed no tracked product-source modifications; source HEAD is the stated commit.
reviewMethod: All source contents were read and hashed, split only at line boundaries, labeled with file-local line numbers, and submitted in structured internal queryWithLLM batches. Batch/range/hash inputs and the complete model answers are retained in review-batches-001.jsonl through review-batches-007.jsonl. Coverage was checked for every file for gaps/overlaps.
exclusions: Tests and test fixtures (test-only source paths); QA/evidence outputs and reports; docs and README material; images/assets/binaries/screenshots
Secrets and environment files/templates; generated files (e.g. next-env.d.ts and Drizzle snapshots/journal); vendor/dependency source; package-lock dependency resolution metadata
